sources.snippet: In addition to the [HfApi], the huggingface_hub library provides [HfFileSystem], a pythonic fsspec-compatible file interface to the Hugging Face Hub. The [HfFileSystem] builds on top of the [HfApi] and offers typical filesystem style operations like cp, mv, ls, du, glob, get_file, and put_file.
